Determine whether exact feature aliasing of balanced original/swapped sequences explains this: a representation discarding distinguishing information imposes an upper bound regardless of classifier; if few collisions occur, optimization, train distribution and model capacity remain open explanations.
freeze: Prior to untouched first use freeze audit seeds1920..1935, 3 generator families, two fixed swap sites, identity/XOR55 recoding after four-bit quantization, five exact representations (full raw reference+observation input, W-R40 scalar, W-R40 lag1/lag2, W-R39 top16), precise collision/empirical lookup math and classification gates. measures: For 16*3*2*9=864 matched positive/negative counterfactual pairs per coding: count exact within-pair identical observed sequences and identical feature encodings for each arm; optimistic matched-pair upper bound=1-(identical_pairs/(2*864)); also count empirical exact-feature positive/negative keys across full 1728 examples to compute an in-sample unrestricted memorization ceiling= sum(max(pos,neg) for each feature key)/1728. Oracle empirical ceiling is NOT candidate performance nor sealed generalization. Save by-seed and by-generator/site counts.
decision: OBSERVATION_LIMIT iff raw_pair exact identity fraction >=0.20; FEATURE_COLLAPSE iff raw_pair identity fraction <0.02 but any invariant arm feature identity fraction >=0.20; UNEXPLAINED_BY_EXACT_PAIR_COLLISION otherwise. Include global collision and upper bound in all classifications, never infer that a linearly limited model reached its theoretical ceiling.
